name: Ballad of the Conqueror on the action bar is saved as Pulverize (#5469)
contract: Inspiring Leader 505344, the Inspiration specialization 20 aura, turns Guardian attacks into Ballads. Synchronize in AscensionGuardianTalents.cpp, run on every guardian_talents::OnPlayerUpdate (AscensionGuardianTalents.cpp:105-108), picks for an active Pulverize 800311 the highest Ballad of the Conqueror rank whose SpellLevel the character has reached (AscensionGuardianTalents.cpp:52-55, 501068 at level 18), teaches it with learnSpell(replacement, true) (AscensionGuardianTalents.cpp:94), a temporary spell never written to character_spell, and registers it with Player::SetTemporarySpellReplacement (AscensionGuardianTalents.cpp:95). The same routine replaces Heavy Blow with Paragon Smash 802629 under 706514 and 707138, and Advance with its stomp 500673. Before the fix Player::_SaveActions wrote 501068 for a button holding the Ballad, and Player::_LoadActions at the next login runs before Synchronize teaches it again, so the button was refused and deleted. persisted_action_button reads Player::GetSavedActionButtonSpell, the id _SaveActions writes. A button holding Ballad of the Conqueror must be saved as Pulverize; a button holding Pulverize is saved unchanged.

steps.label: Inspiring Leader replaces Pulverize with Ballad of the Conqueror
The bar holds Ballad of the Conqueror
The Ballad button is saved as Pulverize
Control: an ordinary known spell is saved unchanged
